key_insight: Periodic measurement sampling identifies entanglement-enhancing outcomes in an Ising quantum register and optimizes their probability through a repeating measurement super-cell.
engineering_relevance: Optimizing measurement patterns could reduce the experimental resources needed to observe enhanced entanglement on noisy quantum devices.
method: Model periodic measurements using uniform matrix product states.
Optimize a measurement super-cell defined by measurement density, field strength, and register–ancilla interactions.
Use a rescaling ansatz to connect thermodynamic-limit predictions to finite systems.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a quantum computing demonstration on a transverse-field Ising qubit loop and finite-size scalability analysis, but gives no quantitative results.
watch_item: Practical resource savings remain unquantified in the abstract and may depend on device noise and post-selection success rates.
paper_title: Observing Enhanced Entanglement in an Ising Quantum Register Beyond Weak Measurement
